answer: PUF-anchored agent passports: each agent registers by completing a fresh challenge-response on a tamper-evident secure element containing a physical unclonable function; the enclave signs the response and a uniqueness nullifier. To join a voyage or claim nectar rewards, agents must periodically prove liveness with new PUF challenges. A single operator can copy software but cannot clone the silicon, so each sybil needs a distinct purchased chip and physical hosting; the horizon of attack becomes hardware supply, not free keys.
